en: A sentence starts with a capital letter, and so does a name like Max.
Days of the week and the word I always have a capital letter.
Names like Sam and the word I always start with a capital letter.
The frog sat on a log.
the frog sat on a log.
The frog sat on a Log.
Only the first word needs a capital here. Log is not a name.
Names of people and places start with a capital letter.
We went to the beach on Saturday.
We went to the Beach on saturday.
we went to the beach on Saturday.
The sentence starts with a capital, and so does the day Saturday.
Start with a capital and write I as a capital. An apple is not a name.
Which word should start with a capital letter?
Tuesday is a day of the week, so it needs a capital T.
Ben and Ava play in the snow.
ben and Ava play in the snow.
Ben and ava play in the Snow.
Ben and Ava are names, so both need capitals. Snow is not a name.
A name starts with one capital letter at the front.
Paris is a place and June is a month, so both need a capital letter.
Which word should start with a capital letter?
Friday is a day of the week, so it needs a capital F.
Tom has a cat called Tiger.
Tom has a cat called tiger.
tom has a cat called Tiger.
Tom and Tiger are both names, so they both start with a capital letter.
Only the first word needs a capital. Raining is not a name.
Which word should start with a capital letter?
London is the name of a city, so it needs a capital L.
The sentence starts with a capital, and months like December do too.
The bus stops at Green Street.
The bus stops at green street.
The Bus stops at Green Street.
Green Street is the name of a place, so it has capitals. Bus is not a name.
Which word should start with a capital letter?
Emma is a girl’s name, so it needs a capital E.
Start the sentence with a capital and always write I as a capital.
Leo and Zara went to the zoo.
Leo and zara went to the zoo.
leo and Zara went to the Zoo.
Leo and Zara are names, so both need capitals. Zoo is not a name.
Wales and England are names of countries, so both need a capital letter.
Which word should start with a capital letter?
Sunday is a day of the week, so it needs a capital S.
Ruby is a name, so it has a capital. Books is not a name.
In winter we make a snowman.
In Winter we make a snowman.
in winter we make a snowman.
The sentence starts with a capital, but seasons like winter do not need one.
A pet’s name starts with one capital letter at the front.
The first word needs a capital, and I is always a capital.
Wednesday is a day, so it needs a capital. Football is not a name.
Which word should start with a capital letter?
Scotland is the name of a country, so it needs a capital S.
A question starts with a capital, and the name Noah does too.
Mr and Brown are part of a name, so both start with a capital letter.
